parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client request token. You can set this parameter to any unique string.

parameters.name: ParamLevel
parameters.description:
The parameter type. Valid values:

- **compute**: compute layer parameter.
- **storage**: storage layer parameter.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: A JSON-formatted string. MapKey specifies the parameter name, and MapValue specifies the parameter value. The modifiable parameters are dynamically added or removed. Call the [DescribeParameterTemplates](~~196856~~) operation to query the available parameters. You can specify multiple parameters at a time.
